name: observability-mcp
description: Production-grade observability server for monitoring MCP ecosystems with OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, and Loki.
author: Sandra Schipal

tools.name: monitor_server_health
tools.description: Perform real-time health check on an MCP server or web service.

tools.name: collect_performance_metrics
tools.description: Collect comprehensive performance metrics for the system or specific service.

tools.name: send_logs_to_loki
tools.description: Send custom log entries to Loki for centralized log aggregation.

tools.name: query_loki_logs
tools.description: Query logs from Loki with advanced filtering and analysis.

tools.name: analyze_log_patterns
tools.description: Analyze log patterns and anomalies using Loki queries.

tools.name: correlate_logs_and_metrics
tools.description: Correlate log entries with metrics for comprehensive incident analysis.
